# Tabulator

`tabulator.min.js` and `tabulator.min.css` are the unmodified browser build of
[Tabulator](https://tabulator.info) 6.3.1 (`tabulator-tables` on npm), from
`dist/js/tabulator.min.js` and `dist/css/tabulator.min.css`.
